monuments.name: Stonehenge
monuments.description: Prehistoric ring of standing sarsen stones on Salisbury Plain, England (c. 3000–2000 BC).

monuments.name: Ahu Tongariki
monuments.description: The largest ceremonial platform on Rapa Nui (Easter Island), with fifteen moai.

monuments.name: Arc de Triomphe
monuments.description: Triumphal arch at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, Paris (completed 1836).

monuments.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
monuments.description: Freestanding bell tower of Pisa Cathedral, famous for its tilt (1173–1372).

monuments.name: Big Ben
monuments.description: The Great Bell and clock tower (Elizabeth Tower) of the Palace of Westminster, London (1859).

monuments.name: Parthenon
monuments.description: Doric temple to Athena on the Acropolis of Athens (447–432 BC).

monuments.name: Statue of Liberty
monuments.description: Copper statue by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi on Liberty Island, New York Harbor (1886).

monuments.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
monuments.description: Nineteenth-century Romanesque Revival palace above Hohenschwangau, Bavaria.

monuments.name: El Castillo (Temple of Kukulcan)
monuments.description: Step pyramid at the heart of the Maya city of Chichén Itzá, Yucatán.

monuments.name: Colosseum
monuments.description: Elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of Rome (completed AD 80).

monuments.name: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury)
monuments.description: Temple façade carved into sandstone in the Nabataean city of Petra, Jordan.

monuments.name: St. Basil’s Cathedral
monuments.description: Church with colourful onion domes on Red Square, Moscow (1555–1561).

monuments.name: Eiffel Tower
monuments.description: Wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, Paris (1889).

monuments.name: Taj Mahal
monuments.description: White marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, Agra (1631–1653).

monuments.name: Angkor Wat
monuments.description: Twelfth-century temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia — the largest religious monument in the world.

monuments.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
monuments.description: The oldest and largest of the Giza pyramids (c. 2560 BC), the last surviving ancient wonder.

monuments.name: Machu Picchu
monuments.description: Fifteenth-century Inca citadel on a ridge above the Urubamba valley, Peru.

monuments.name: Hagia Sophia
monuments.description: Domed building in Istanbul, completed in AD 537 under Justinian I.

monuments.name: Great Torii of Itsukushima
monuments.description: The vermilion gate of Itsukushima Shrine that seems to float at high tide, Miyajima, Japan (current gate 1875).

monuments.name: Windmills of Kinderdijk
monuments.description: Eighteenth-century polder windmills along the canals of Kinderdijk, the Netherlands.

monuments.name: Wayfinder’s Cairn
monuments.description: Fictional: a stacked-stone cairn crowned with a brass compass, where Atlas explorers leave directions for each other.

monuments.name: Brandenburg Gate
monuments.description: Neoclassical gate by Carl Gotthard Langhans crowned by the Quadriga, Berlin (1791).

monuments.name: Tower of Hercules
monuments.description: The oldest Roman lighthouse still in use, A Coruña, Spain (1st–2nd century AD).

monuments.name: Lantern Lighthouse
monuments.description: Fictional: a striped lighthouse ringed by floating paper lanterns that guide night-time explorers home.

monuments.name: Golden Gate Bridge
monuments.description: Art Deco suspension bridge in International Orange across the Golden Gate strait, San Francisco (1937).

monuments.name: Himeji Castle
monuments.description: The 'White Heron' — a hilltop Japanese castle with tiered white keeps (1609).

monuments.name: Floating Observatory
monuments.description: Fictional: a domed star observatory on a rock island that hovers over a mirror-still pool.

monuments.name: Temple of Heaven
monuments.description: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests with its triple blue-tiled roof, Beijing (1420; rebuilt 1889).

monuments.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
monuments.description: Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité with twin towers, rose windows and flying buttresses (1163–1345).

monuments.name: Clockwork Compass Tower
monuments.description: Fictional: a brass-and-copper clockwork tower whose great compass rose turns toward undiscovered places.

monuments.name: Great Sphinx of Giza
monuments.description: Limestone lion with a human head guarding the Giza plateau, Egypt (c. 2500 BC).

monuments.name: Potala Palace
monuments.description: The White and Red Palaces rising up Marpo Ri hill, Lhasa (17th century).

monuments.name: Skyward Harbour
monuments.description: Fictional: a lighthouse spire where airships moor on brass rings before setting off to chart the skies.

monuments.name: Borobudur
monuments.description: Ninth-century Buddhist temple of stacked terraces and bell-shaped stupas, Central Java, Indonesia.

monuments.name: Crystal Spire of the Cartographers
monuments.description: Fictional: a cluster of glowing crystals circled by golden rings, said to hold every route ever charted.

monuments.name: Farnese Atlas
monuments.description: Ancient Roman marble of the Titan Atlas kneeling beneath the celestial globe — the oldest known depiction of the constellations — National Archaeological Museum, Naples (2nd century AD).

skins.name: Coastal Explorer
skins.description: Bright coasts: turquoise water, sandy land, crisp white roads.

skins.name: Classic Road Atlas
skins.description: The glovebox road atlas: red highways, yellow main roads, pale land.

skins.name: Soft Terrain
skins.description: Muted sage and clay tones with gentle, low-contrast labels.

skins.name: Ocean Cartographer
skins.description: Deep marine blues, sea-glass land and fine navy linework.

skins.name: Woodland Trails
skins.description: Forest greens, bark-brown paths and moss-coloured parks.

skins.name: Desert Expedition
skins.description: Sun-baked ochre land, terracotta roads and oasis-blue water.

skins.name: Midnight Navigator
skins.description: Night-mode cartography: ink-blue land, glowing amber roads.

skins.name: Vintage Survey
skins.description: A survey sheet on aged paper: sepia ink and italic labels.

skins.name: Alpine Explorer
skins.description: Glacier whites, slate roads and icy lake blues.

skins.name: Golden Cartography
skins.description: Gilded linework on deep green, like an illuminated chart.

skins.name: Imperial Atlas
skins.description: Crimson and ivory with gold borders — a ceremonial state atlas.

skins.name: Celestial Routes
skins.description: A star chart: midnight sky, star-field background and a navigational grid.

skins.name: Royal Treasure Map
skins.description: Parchment texture, burnt-umber ink and red-dashed routes.

skins.name: Deep-Sea Navigator
skins.description: Bioluminescent teal linework over abyssal blue.

skins.name: Ancient World Atlas
skins.description: Faded fresco tones and serif-italic labels of an old world atlas.

skins.name: Living Parchment
skins.description: Hand-inked parchment with a vignette and graticule grid.

skins.name: Astral Cartographer
skins.description: Violet nebula land, star-field sky and luminous constellation routes.

skins.name: Worldmaker’s Atlas
skins.description: Jewel-toned continents, golden roads and a parchment-and-gold frame.

skins.name: Paper Sketch
skins.description: A pencil sketch on cream paper: graphite roads and hand-lettered italic labels.

skins.name: Mint Transit
skins.description: Clean transit-map look: mint parks, green motorways and red rail lines.

skins.name: Harvest Fields
skins.description: Wheat-gold land, olive parks and linen texture, like a farmer’s almanac map.

skins.name: Cherry Blossom
skins.description: Blush-pink parks and plum labels, with petals drifting across the map.

skins.name: Nordic Frost
skins.description: Frosted whites and fjord blues on a linen texture.

skins.name: Terracotta Villa
skins.description: Mediterranean terracotta roofs, olive groves and a deep-blue sea.

skins.name: Blueprint
skins.description: An engineer’s blueprint: white linework and a measuring grid on Prussian blue.

skins.name: Autumn Ember
skins.description: Maple-red woods, amber parks and rust-coloured roads.

skins.name: Tropical Lagoon
skins.description: Vivid lagoon turquoise, palm greens and coral highways.

skins.name: Neon Metropolis
skins.description: After-dark synthwave city: magenta and cyan neon roads with twinkling lights.

skins.name: Jade Dynasty
skins.description: Carved-jade greens with gold and lacquer-red roads on silk-like linen.

skins.name: Arctic Aurora
skins.description: A polar night under a slowly dancing aurora and a field of stars.

skins.name: Volcanic Forge
skins.description: Obsidian land, molten lava roads and embers rising from the forge.

skins.name: Sunken Atlantis
skins.description: A drowned city in aquamarine with gilded avenues and shimmering light.

skins.name: Samurai Ink
skins.description: Sumi-ink brushwork on washi paper, sealed with vermilion red.

skins.name: Dragon’s Hoard
skins.description: Crimson and gold treasure-vault cartography, glittering with sparks.

skins.name: Eternal Garden
skins.description: An endless garden at dusk where fireflies drift over lush green paths.

skins.name: Clockmaker’s Chart
skins.description: Brass, copper and sepia on aged parchment with a precision grid.

skins.name: Atlas of the Heavens
skins.description: The sky Atlas carries: a living star chart with gold constellation routes, aurora and shooting stars.
